titleZh: 「The first ／ last ／ next time + clause」表達「首次、上次及下次」
titleEn: Using “The first / last / next time + clause”

formula: The first / last / next time + subject + verb, + main clause.

formulas.formula: The first / last / next time + subject + verb, + main clause.
Main clause + the first / last / next time + subject + verb.
Subject + remember / recall / will never forget + the first / last time + clause.
It / This is the first time + subject + has / have + past participle.
It / This / That was the first time + subject + had + past participle.
It / That was the last time + subject + verb.
The first / last / next time + clause + be / main verb.
Imperative / modal / future clause + the next time + subject + present verb.

meaning.zh: The first / last / next time + 子句 用來指出某件事首次發生、最近或最後一次發生，以及下一次將會發生的場合。

rules.zh: next time 子句談論未來時通常使用現在式而不是 will。
rules.en: When a next time clause refers to the future, it normally uses the present simple rather than will.

rules.zh: first time 可按觀察時間點配合過去式、現在完成式或過去完成式。
rules.en: First time can combine with the past simple, present perfect or past perfect according to the viewpoint in time.

rules.zh: last time 可表示最近一次或最終一次，實際意思須按上下文判斷，不一定表示永遠不再發生。
rules.en: Last time can mean the most recent occasion or the final occasion, depending on context; it does not necessarily mean that the event will never happen again.

rules.zh: the first / last / next time + 子句 本身表示時間時，前面通常不加 at、on 或 in。
rules.en: Do not add an unnecessary preposition such as at, on or in before the first / last / next time + clause when it already functions as a time expression.

rules.zh: the first time 後的關係詞 that 通常可以省略；本練習主要使用較簡潔的形式。
rules.en: That can normally be omitted after the first time; this exercise mainly uses the more concise form.

rules.zh: 目標表達可放在句首、句末、記憶動詞後、It is / It was 結構內，或作整句主語，不必機械地每次放在句首。
rules.en: The target can appear at the beginning or end, after a memory verb, within an It is / It was structure, or as the subject of a sentence. It need not always begin the answer.

benefits.zh: 它清楚指出所說的是第一次、最近一次、最後一次還是下一次，準確識別某次場合。
benefits.en: It identifies an exact occasion by distinguishing the earliest, most recent, final or following occasion.

benefits.zh: 它把某次事件與當時發生的事情直接連接起來，不必寫成兩句互不相連的短句。
benefits.en: It connects an event with what happened on that occasion instead of presenting two disconnected sentences.

benefits.zh: first time 可介紹經歷的開始，last time 可回顧最近或最終場合，幫助有條理地敘述事件。
benefits.en: It helps you tell stories in a clear order by marking the beginning, most recent occasion or final occasion.

benefits.zh: next time 清楚指出指示、承諾或建議應何時實行，使未來安排更精確。
benefits.en: It makes future instructions more precise by stating exactly when an instruction, promise or suggestion should be followed.

benefits.zh: 它可放在 remember、recall 和 forget 等動詞後，自然描述難忘或記憶模糊的經歷。
benefits.en: It helps you describe memorable experiences naturally after verbs such as remember, recall and forget.

benefits.zh: 它可以作開首或句末時間子句、記憶動詞受詞、It is / It was 結構的一部分或整句主語，提供多種真正不同的句式。
benefits.en: It gives you several genuine sentence patterns: an opening or final time clause, the object of a memory verb, part of an It is / It was structure, or the subject of a sentence.
